purpose: Source-only verification of a report helper whose SQL and bind tuple are passed through local call sites into a query wrapper.
supported_shape: A local query wrapper passes formal SQL and parameter names directly to execute/query; every direct call in the same module supplies a string-literal SQL argument and a positional tuple/list without starred elements.
negative_case: A wrapper callsite with computed SQL or a nonliteral parameter container remains unresolved.
acceptance_limit: This AST contract checks literal source call sites and bind arity. It does not establish tenant isolation, PostgreSQL execution, populated output parity, or behavior for indirect/external wrapper callers.
